notes:
# Orvio 0.14

- "Who's watching?" appears every time Orvio starts, and straight after you create an account: name your first profile and pick an avatar before anything else.
- Avatars that showed half of the next picture are fixed.
- Categories show their country or language again, for example "NL · NETFLIX" and "EN · AMAZON PRIME".
- The Home banner shows well-rated titles in your languages instead of whatever was added last.
- The Default button is gone: Movies and Series show All, Favorites and A–Z.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
